blurb: Brassneck Brewery brews a wide variety of beers on a small system with many fermenters, offering fresh beer direct from conditioning tanks. The tasting room features about 12 different taps with diverse beer styles. Snacks are available from their sister restaurant, The Magnet, including in-house snacks and oven-ready items for home.
